owner_calls.question: Should Reed, Sue, Johnny and Ben (A:reed-richards, A:sue-storm, A:johnny-storm, A:ben-grimm) get a past-group stage for ANSA (American National Space Agency), the agency the MCU wiki says ran their 1961 Excelsior cosmic-ray mission, told in the opening flashback of The Fantastic Four: First Steps?
options: Add ANSA as a past stage keyed to The Fantastic Four: First Steps before their current groups
Leave as is (the film frames the flight as Reed's own mission; on-screen naming of ANSA not confirmed)
owner_calls.evidence: MCU wiki lists all four as ANSA astronauts on the ANSA Excelsior Mission (flashback in First Steps), but its staff table cites an Empire interview, and Reed says on screen 'It was my mission'. I could not confirm the name ANSA is said or shown on screen, so no change proposed.
